title: Control effectiveness — EDR script-block logging
summary: Share of detections that fire against telemetry actually emitted under the script-block logging control. Drops when endpoints regress out of the control's intended configuration, exposing the playbook to blind spots. Lower-bounded by detection true-positive rate and upper-bounded by control deployment coverage.

target.rationale: Below 0.9 indicates configuration drift on protected endpoints.

measurement.formula: count(detection firings on endpoints attesting control compliant) / count(detection firings) over window.

inputs.name: attested
inputs.description: endpoint attestation state for the control
